title: Saffire-I · Numune 1
subtitle: Cygnus uzay aracında kaydedilmiş gerçek deney ölçümleri

source.fileName: PSI-98_Raw Data_Saffire-I Sample 1 Sensor Data Complete TM graphs.xlsx
source.calibration: Values are cached numeric results in NASA workbook Calibrated Data sheet; no new calibration or offset applied.

context.platform: Uncrewed Cygnus cargo spacecraft after separation from ISS
context.objective: Observe large-scale microgravity flame growth and compare material flammability behavior with normal-gravity screening.
unknowns: No full US Lab component-to-material inventory in this data
No arbitrary-material or arbitrary-geometry fire prediction
No sensor alarm threshold or fire-onset classification truth exported

sampling.method: Nearest original row to each integer elapsed second, plus final original row and exact igniter-on, igniter-off, and fan-off transition rows with their immediately preceding original rows; duplicates removed and rows sorted by source time. Ties choose earlier row. No averaging, smoothing, interpolation or normalization.
sampling.timestampTimezone: Not asserted; use source elapsed seconds for replay
sampling.intervalNote: Approximately 1 second except for exact preserved event boundaries; use each row's actual time.

events.label: Ateşleyici etkin
events.note: Observed igniter current rises above 1 A; not an independently annotated first-flame timestamp.

events.label: Ateşleyici akımı kesildi
events.note: First off sample 68.013 s; last energized sample 67.980 s. Current crosses below 1 A.

events.label: Deney fanı güç komutu kapandı
events.note: Recorded test-section fan power command changes 1 to 0. This does not specify immediate extinction.

limitations: This is recorded Saffire-I data from Cygnus, not a fire measured inside US Lab.
3D flame/smoke display is illustrative and must not be presented as computed fire propagation.
Temperatures refer to specific thermocouple locations, not uniform cabin or flame temperature.
O2 and CO2 are the workbook calibrated sensor channels; do not replace with summary-derived oxygen estimates.
Sparse nearest-sample export omits between-sample peaks and must not be used for quantitative threshold validation.
Any user-controlled suppression, airflow, material or geometry change is outside this recorded experiment.
Small negative currents and instrument noise are retained, not clamped to zero.
